items.name: Finnish FMC Series XI 2025
items.information:
**This is an FMC only competition. No speedsolving events will be held.**
Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor.

**Tämän kisan ainoa laji on vähiten siirtoja. Speedsolving -lajeja ei pidetä.**
Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua.
Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija.

items.name: Rubik's FMC Italy 2025
items.information:
![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/YSp2SyW.png)

This competition will assign the title of *2025 national champion*  for the event 3x3x3 Fewest Moves.
It will take place in Castel Maggiore (Bologna), Milan, Monterotondo (Rome) and Valverde (Catania) simultaneously.

![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/yztC4Jt.png)

Questa competizione assegnerà il titolo di *campione nazionale 2025* per l'evento 3x3x3 Fewest Moves.
Si svolgerà a Castel Maggiore (Bologna), Milano, Monterotondo (Roma) e Valverde (Catania) in contemporanea.

items.name: Glasgow Autumn Beginners 2025

venue.name: Learning and Teaching Building, Strathclyde University

items.information:
## We have reopened registration for this competition, so it is now possible to register right up until 3:00pm on the day of the competition!
###If you arrive later than 20 minutes before the scheduled end time of an event, you will not be allowed to compete in that event.

### This competition is targeted at **first-time competitors and less experienced competitors**, but everyone is welcome. 

### Please note that while this competition is open to anyone to attend, **only competitors who have attended 2 or fewer competitions before will be eligible for medals**.

PLEASE NOTE: This is a Series Competition with [Glasgow Autumn Open 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GlasgowAutumnOpen2025). You may only attend ONE of these competitions. Please see further details on the [Series Competition tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GlasgowAutumnBeginners2025#65192-series-competition-information).

Please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

items.name: Quad Cities Sunday 2025
items.information:
While we welcome first-timers at this competition, it is geared towards more experienced competitors. First timers are encouraged to check out [Quad Cities Saturday 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/QuadCitiesSaturday2025) on Saturday instead. These competitions are not in series, so competitors may compete at one or both of the competitions.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association.](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dEIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a6239c56608b03fda2194e41dd545ce91819975d/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png)

items.name: Ohio Quiet Championship 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA5NzA4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b74140b6fa16072de5c55ff126a820c6463e395e/1000016325.png)

Only competitors from Ohio are eligible for the title of Ohio Champion. See [Ohio Champion Title Eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OhioQuietChampionship2025#59667-ohio-champion-title-eligibility) for details.

**Note: This competition will only include quiet events and is not suitable for new competitors.**

If you are new to competing, please consider registering for the [Ohio Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OhioChampionship2025) instead.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
